actions.name: EVALUATE
actions.description: builds the kernel from work/perf_takehome.py as it stands and runs the frozen simulator on two seeds; label names the change being measured in one word or with hyphens, such as vector-hash; spaces need --params

goal.text: Make the kernel in work/perf_takehome.py use fewer clock cycles on the simulated machine than the best so far; the unmodified kernel takes 147734. Edit only work/perf_takehome.py: the files under work/tests/ and work/problem.py must stay as they are and N_CORES stays 1. An evaluation (EVALUATE) is the only measurement that counts.
